description: The build chain: the tools a PC needs to BUILD the ISO, installed on demand by scripts/Install-BuildTools.ps1 (Run-Prepare.cmd, or Run-Build.cmd when a tool is missing) and never part of the image. 'installers' are also carried in the ISO's BuildInputs folder (restored to C:\W11Kit\work\installers) so a reinstalled PC can install them offline; scripts/Get-Installers.py fetches them into C:\W11Kit\work\installers. 'adk' is only pinned here and downloaded from Microsoft when needed (a web installer: it fetches the Deployment Tools itself; the ISO carries oscdimg). Each file is checked against its SHA-256 before use and, at install time, its Authenticode signature must be Valid with exactly this signer subject. Bump version, file, URL, hash and signer together (docs/dev/MAINTAINING.md, 'Updating the build tools').
